version: 0.4.0
kind: governance-manifest
schema_type: governance

metadata:
  udi: prismata.meta.schema.governance-manifest
  name: governance-manifest.schema
  description: Canonical schema for governance manifests.

spec:
  target_kind: governance-manifest
  naming:
    file_suffix: .manifest.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true

fields:
  - name: udi
    path: udi
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: id
    path: id
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: name
    path: name
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: version
    path: version
    type: string
    required: true

  - name: description
    path: description
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: roles
    path: roles
    type: array
    required: false
    item:
      type: object

  - name: permissions
    path: permissions
    type: array
    required: false
    item:
      type: object

  - name: policies
    path: policies
    type: array
    required: false
    item:
      type: object

object:
  udi: ""
  id: ""
  name: ""
  version: ""
  description: ""
  roles: []
  permissions: []
  policies: []
